name: Réacteur Abyssal
brief: The floor of a vast submerged cyber-gothic industrial reactor chamber. A broad flat metal circular arena fills the central two thirds, etched with three concentric FLUSH brass and dark iron maintenance tracks, no raised walls on tracks. Four broad dry radial access routes cut through the outer machine ring from each cardinal edge. At the extreme perimeter: huge turbine sockets, riveted cooling pipes, cyan glass pressure cells, purple energy conduits and restrained orange heat vents. Center fully EMPTY, no reactor column/core/pit. The reactor machinery frames the playable floor from outside only. A cool blue-black steel palette with cyan energy and amber heating accents, careful tactile industrial materials, concentric-circle composition.

No characters, enemies, towers, core building, UI, text, lettering, labels, grid or watermark. Do not render collision obstacles crossing the playable surface. All image pixels opaque.
